tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Weak compactness] ↗ def:weak-convergence ↗ def:dual-pairing-reflexive-banach-space 1. appD:thm-3\group Functional Analysis

If $X$ is reflexive and $\{ u_k\} _{k=1}^\infty \subset X$ is bounded, then some subsequence satisfies \[ u_{k_j}\rightharpoonup u \] for an element $u\in X$.

Consequently, every bounded sequence in a Hilbert space has a weakly convergent subsequence.
